CustomField.description: Checked by Analytics when a Account using the inbound calls product has low fill rate or low mrate. When field is checked, it triggers case creation "Inbound Calls - Issue Outreach" via the flow Account_IBCLowFillRate_CreateCase_LowFillRate. Field is unchecked by this same flow x days after it was triggered. S3P-1237 - Deprecated. Will be deleted after grace period.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Checked by Analytics when an Account has low fill rate or monetization rate for Inbound Calls. Triggers case creation for Support Rep.
CustomField.label: IBC Low Fill Rate Case Trigger (Depr.)
